subject: general
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

I don't fancy __to go out__ this evening.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'going out'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined part in the given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• "I fancy" needs a **noun/object complement**
 
• Thus, participle will be used as the **noun complement,** which is also termed as **'gerund'**.
 
• Here,** 'going out' **should be used instead of** 'to go out'.**
 
• Thus, the correct answer is** Option 4.**

 

**Correct Sentence:**__ *I don't fancy **going out** this evening.*
